protocol.bootstrap: iid whole UTC days (block = 1 day) from DEV+VAL, same source day for both core symbols, bars and funding together
protocol.reduced_pipeline: G8 not run (upper bound); determinism/lookahead skipped (code properties); validity, liquidation, activity, G1-G7, G9 as in the evaluator; 200 shifts; 12 jitters

verdict.rule: STOP if null pass rate > 5% or ANY trend family's power at scale 1.5 < 50% (per-family reading, the stricter one)
